item.title: Privacy Policy
item.author: Unknown
item.description:
This policy covers how I handle your information when you use my services or contact me through jmit.ca.

What I Collect

  • Contact Details. You provide your name, email, phone number if you choose to share it, and details about your issue. This comes through the service request form or by Email, Discord, etc.
  • Remote Sessions. During remote support, I can see your screen. I do not record sessions, retain screenshots, or store any of your personal files.
  • Payments. e-Transfer payments are processed through Interac. I do not see or store your banking details.
  • Site Analytics. I do collect visitor statistics for the jmit.ca website through my own infrastructure (no third-parties such as Google). I also store browser data for functional purposes of the jmit.ca website.

What I Don’t Collect

  • I do not sell, share, or give your information to anyone.
  • I do not store passwords or credentials you share during a support session.

How Your Information Is Used

Your information is used to respond to your inquiry, provide the service you’ve requested, and send invoices or follow up on completed work. Nothing else.

Third-Party Services

  • Google Forms. The service request form is hosted by Google. Their privacy policy applies to form submissions.
  • RustDesk. Remote support sessions use RustDesk, connected through a server that I operate. Session data passes through my server only during the active session and is not stored.

Data Retention

I keep your contact information and service history for bookkeeping and follow-up. If you want me to delete your information, I will do so. Just contact me directly with your request.

See the contacts page for more details.

item.title: Common Questions
item.author: Unknown
item.description:
What is Remote Support?

I connect to your computer using secure remote access software. You can see everything I’m doing on your screen. Most issues can be resolved this way. It means we both get to stay home. 😉

Securty during Remote Sessions

I use industry-standard remote access tools. You can watch everything happening on screen, and you can disconnect the session at any time. I do not store any of your personal data.

What if your problem can’t be fixed remotely?

I offer in-home support in Haldimand and Norfolk County.

What payments do I accept?

I accept cash payment, as well as Interac e-Transfer.

Do I work on Android devices, Macs or other Apple products?

My focus is Windows and Linux systems. I have limited experience repairing and supporting Apple/Android devices. If you have an Apple/Android related question, feel free to reach out. I may still be able to help.

Do you sell computer parts?

For custom builds, I help you choose the right parts for your budget and build the system for you. You purchase the parts directly (I can send you the links), or I can order them on your behalf.

What are my hours of operation?

I am available for work 9:00am - 5:00pm, every day of the week. I respond to all inquiries within 24 business hours.

Where do you begin?

Fill out this Service Request Form

Or contact me directly. See the contacts page for more details.

item.author: Unknown
item.description:
ServicePriceRate
Remote support$50 CADhourly
In-home support$60 CADhourly
Malware remediation$80 CADflat rate
Custom PC Build (labour)$150 CADflat rate

Remote support is preferred when possible. In-home visits are available in Haldimand & Norfolk County.

Payment is due on completion. I accept the following:

  • Interac e-Transfer ( mail@jmit.ca )
  • Cash

I am available for work 9:00am - 5:00pm, every day of the week.

Details

Remote & In-home Support

I can offer personal (non-commercial) IT support. This includes but is not limited to:

  • New computer setup
  • Fixing Printer misconfiguration
  • Fixing Router / Network misconfiguration

If you have an issue that isn’t listed please feel free to reach out. My knowledge is broad and it is likely that I can create a solution for you.

Malware Remediation

A complete system diagnostic scan, followed by removal of all detected malware. If you have been the victim of an online or phone scam then this service can help you.

Custom PC Build

An end-to-end custom PC assembly service, offered at a flat-rate fee. I provide advice on part selection given your requirements and budget, and perform full assembly of your new machine, as well as initial software setup.

I am very detail oriented, and strive to ensure that my customers are fully satisfied e.g. ensuring good cable management and RGB lighting effect installation.

item.title: Terms of Service
item.author: Unknown
item.description:
These terms apply to all services that I provide through jmit.ca. They must be agreed upon before any work can proceed.

Estimates and Pricing

Current pricing is listed on the services page.

I will give you an estimate before any hourly rated work is done. This does not constitute a guarantee of total cost. Every reasonable effort will be made to adhere to the estimate, and I will notify you promptly if any additional work is required for completion of the service.

You are free to cancel the service at any time, and will only be charged for the time that has been spent.

Payment

  • Payment is due on completion of work.
  • Accepted payment methods: cash or Interac e-Transfer sent to mail@jmit.ca.

Remote Support

  • Remote support sessions require your consent. You can see everything happening on your screen and can disconnect at any time.
  • I do not access files, accounts, or data beyond what’s needed to resolve your issue.
  • I am not responsible for pre-existing issues discovered during a session.

For more information, see the remote support page.

In-Home Support

  • I offer In-home support to any address in Haldimand / Norfolk County.
  • You will make every reasonable effort to provide a respectful and safe work environment.

Liability

I will do my absolute best to resolve your issue, but success cannot be guaranteed. Some problems cannot be fixed, and some hardware is beyond repair. By agreeing to these terms, you acknowledge the following:

  • Data loss. I am not responsible for any data loss that occurs before, during, or after service. It is your responsibility to back up your data before any work begins. I will remind you, but the responsibility is yours alone.
  • Pre-existing conditions. I am not responsible for issues that existed before service began, including hardware failure, software corruption, or malware that was already present on your system.
  • Third-party products. I am not responsible for the behaviour of software, hardware, or services made by other companies. If a Windows update breaks something after I leave, I cannot be held responsible.
  • Limit of liability. My total liability for any service is limited to the amount you paid for that service. I am not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages, including but not limited to lost revenue, lost data, or downtime.
  • No warranty. All services are provided as-is, with no express or implied warranty of any kind. I am absolutely willing to help with follow-up questions or issues when I can — just know that any after-service support is provided as a courtesy and cannot be guaranteed.

Custom PC Builds

  • You are responsible for aquiring the neccessary components of the build. I can offer guidance on part selection and can assist in placing orders.
  • My labour charge covers assembly and initial setup.
  • Components are covered by their manufacturer warranties, not by me.
  • I guarantee my assembly work — I take full responsibility for errors made in my own work.

Cancellations

You are free to cancel scheduled service before the agreed upon date and time. It will be very much appreciated if you give as much advance notice as possible.
